verdict.rationale: Relay's support docs say applicants can check their application status anytime from the homepage while it is under review. Reviews typically take 1–2 business days, and Relay emails the applicant when a decision is made. Only this single first-party mention supports the story, with no detail on what the status view shows. missing for 10: detailed documentation of the status view (stages, requested documents), independent or hands-on corroboration.
